method: STEP assembly imported with Open CASCADE; placed component bounding planes measured in millimetres, converted at 25.4 mm/in. Floor axes are X and Z; Y is height. Bounds include the CAD kernel tolerance, negligible at reported 0.001-inch precision.
limitations: These describe this specific downloadable BIOBUZZ CAD assembly, not guaranteed measurements for every physical field. Tile batches, assembly, and perimeter design vary.
